name: Fox Drive, Campbell Bridge
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is the horizontal length of that OSM way, WGS84 haversine with radius 6378137 m, rounded to one decimal. These ways match the live OpenStreetMap node counts on 2026-10-14, so the stored polylines are the complete ways. An approach plan_length_m is still not the climb to grade. No published structural length was found for this deck. Quesnell lengths 315 m, 319.8 m, and 333 m are not used here.
dropped_note: The extract lists footway 25475768 first. That way is a trail about 170 m south of Fox Drive and is excluded. Path 840389481 is about 180 m north, toward Quesnell, and is excluded. This file keeps only the Fox Drive / Campbell Bridge decks and the two paths on this crossing. Fort Edmonton Park Road, Keillor Road, and the other trail stubs are excluded.

decks.which: Fox Drive NW on the south carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, secondary, width tag 11.1, tagged bridge:name Campbell Bridge. Node order is west to east, so the one-way is eastbound. This centreline is 88.7 m. That is not a published structural length. Quesnell lengths are not used here.

Fox Drive NW on the east part of the north carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, secondary, width tag 11.1, tagged bridge:name Campbell Bridge. Node order is east to west, so the one-way is westbound. Continues as way 944470767. This centreline is 67.1 m.

Fox Drive NW on the west part of the north carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, secondary, width tag 11.1, tagged bridge:name Campbell Bridge. Continues way 25475833 west. This centreline is 22.1 m. With way 25475833 it is 89.2 m.
Shared-use path on the north side of the deck. OpenStreetMap tags it as a cycleway with foot and bicycle designated, surface concrete, layer 2. Node order is west to east. This centreline is 89.5 m.

South sidewalk. OpenStreetMap tags it as a footway, footway=sidewalk on a live read, surface concrete, layer 1. Node order is east to west. This centreline is 89.3 m. Layer 1 is the mapper tag. The road ways are layer 2.

approaches.which: Fox Drive NW onto the west end of the south carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, 70 km/h, width tag 11.1. Node order runs toward the deck. The far node is not a surveyed grade point.

Fox Drive NW leaving the west end of the north carriageway. Four lanes, one-way, 70 km/h, width tag 14.6. Node order runs away from the deck toward Fort Edmonton Park Road and Whitemud. The far node is not a surveyed grade point.
Fox Drive NW leaving the east end of the south carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, 70 km/h, width tag 11.1. Node order runs away from the deck. The far node is not a surveyed grade point.
Fox Drive NW onto the east end of the north carriageway. Three lanes, one-way, 70 km/h, width tag 11.1. Node order runs toward the deck. The far node is not a surveyed grade point.

excluded.reason: Footway, 28.6 m, layer 1, about 170 m south of Fox Drive. A trail crossing, not this deck. The extract listed it first.
Path, 46.5 m, layer 1, about 180 m north of Fox Drive toward Quesnell. A different crossing. Not this file.
Fort Edmonton Park Road NW, 185.3 m, west of this deck. A valley road, not the Fox Drive climb.
Keillor Road, 388.9 m, east of this deck. A park road, not the Fox Drive climb.
R6 Quesnell east carriageway. River span. Not this file.
R6 Quesnell west carriageway. Not this file.

dimensions.structural_type: Road bridge over Whitemud Creek. No published girder, beam, or truss name was found. OSM road ways have no bridge:structure tag. The 2012 photograph shows a deck with a metal railing. It is not a truss.
